JRC_MIGRATIONS.TITLE: Data Migration Center
JRC_MIGRATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Stage and review source records before loading them into this account. Existing importers remain available.
JRC_MIGRATIONS.FILE: JSON or comma-separated CSV · up to 500 rows / 2 MB
JRC_MIGRATIONS.MAPPING_HELP: Select the source column for each destination field. legacy_id, created_at and updated_at are required. Dates must include a time zone; existing relations must belong to this account.
JRC_MIGRATIONS.EXECUTION_HELP: Only rows approved by validation will be applied. Ambiguous and rejected rows remain blocked. Existing records are never merged by email or name alone.
JRC_MIGRATIONS.REPORT_LIMIT: This comparison checks the staged rows against current destination records. It does not certify that the official source was fully exported.
JRC_MIGRATIONS.ERROR: The operation could not be completed. Check your permission and validate the batch again.
JRC_MIGRATIONS.FILE_ERROR: Invalid file. Use a JSON array or comma-separated CSV, with at most 500 rows and 2 MB.
JRC_MIGRATIONS.FILE_LIMIT: File manifests must include original name, bytes, size and SHA-256. Each file is limited to 1 MB; the manifest limit remains 2 MB.
